newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana shares end higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana shares end higher in thin trade.

text.p: Share prices firmed on the Ghana Stock Exchange on Monday, with no losers, but volume was low, the market report showed.
The All-Share index rose 0.16 point to 385.58, up from Friday's 385.42. The total number of shares traded was 16,200, down from 40,820 on Friday.

The rise was led by Pioneer Aluminium Factory, up 15 cedis to 130 cedis. The other main gainers were Standard Chartered Bank, up 10 cedis to 5,010 cedis, Pioneer Tobacco Company, up five cedis to 260 cedis and Mechanical LLoyd, up one cedi to 86 cedis.

Commenting on the recent market trend, one market player said: "Sentiment is slightly bearish ahead of Wednesday's statutory public holiday, which accounts for the sloppiness of business at the Bourse."
